newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest-July 11.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest-July 11.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet and Brand-name Products. ******************************************
ADVERTISING & MARKETING:

PARIS - A campaign by Young & Rubicam for hypermarket chain Auchan wins this week's IPSOS-Strategies award for strong recognition. Putting two posters next to each other got around rules for maximum poster size in France, while the campaign itself presented Auchan as a friendly neighbourhood store which bakes bread, fixes bikes and takes back unopened champagne bottles.
(Strategies)

PARIS - Michael Madel, chairman of J. Walter Thompson for Europe, the Middle East and South Africa, wants to take his agency from number 14 in France to within the top 10 in the next three years. (Strategies)

PARIS - Suzuki, one of the few car makers to boost sales in the depressed French car market, puts its success down to working closely with its advertising agency to give the car an image as the family pet, contact with concessionaires, and keeping its price ultra-competitive. (Strategies)
MEDIA & THE INTERNET:

PARIS - French music radio group NRJ says its net attributable profit rose 33 percent to 57.55 million francs ($9.7 million) in the first half of 1997, and it expects its second half to be stronger. (Les Echos, La Tribune)
PARIS - French thematic channels are seeking ways to reach breakeven. But those which manage it keep it quiet, fearing price pressure from the cable operators. (Strategies)
PARIS - The French public television channels say they are launching a history channel on the symbolic date of July 14, to be carried on France's cable and satellite TV services. (Reuter)
PARIS - French pay-television group Canal Plus could reduce its stake in Italian broadcaster Telepiu to less than 51 percent, Canal chairman Pierre Lescure tells Le Monde in an interview.
(Reuter)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:
PARIS - This year French kids prefer Kinder chocolate eggs and pocket-sized cakes to Coca-Cola, which used to take top place, a study into French children's brand preferences shows. (Reuter)
PARIS - Lancome, a subsidiary of French cosmetics group L'Oreal, is planning to launch a new night cream simultaneously in several markets from September, Lancome officials tell Reuters. (Reuter)
PARIS - French carmaker Renault says it has rolled out one million Twingos -- those quirky minicars that jazzed up the economy segment. (Reuter)
